abort.single_instance_allowed: Home in Review is already set up.

user.title: Home in Review
user.description: A monthly report of your home, made from your energy dashboard, local weather and indoor sensors. Reports appear in the sidebar.

data_description.backfill_months: Earlier months are generated in the background from long-term statistics, so you have a full year right away. Use 0 to skip.

data.notify_services: Notify when a report is ready

data_description.notify_services: The notification links to the report.
data_description.report_day: The report for the previous month is made on this day.
data_description.excluded_areas: Sensors in these areas are left out of the indoor climate. Garden, garage and similar areas are suggested.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Without it, outdoor temperature comes from Open-Meteo for your area.
data_description.fixed_costs_daily: Optional, including tax: standing charges and grid fees. Use a negative monthly amount for a fixed tax credit.
data_description.max_hourly_kwh: Meter jumps above this (per hour) are treated as glitches and skipped.

generate.name: Generate report
generate.description: Collects (or re-collects) the report for one month.

month.name: Month
month.description: As YYYY-MM. Defaults to last month.

backfill.name: Backfill reports
backfill.description: Generates missing reports for earlier months in the background.

months.name: Months
months.description: How many months to look back.
